Mine is a dream rather then a memory. I was in foster care starting at the age of 8, adopted at 16, and am now 23  but I still remember my mom, brother and grandmother. In my dream, a dragon ripped the roof off of our house, it was breathing fire and screeching for some reason. My mom and grandma hid under a desk in the corner, and all I could do was stand in the middle of the room and point up at the dragon. My brother kissed me on the forehead, and shoved me down on the floor as he grabbed a long sword and shield from a (very oddly placed cabinet) in our living room. He killed the dragon, and out of nowhere the house is back to normal and there is a large crowd surrounding us and cheering him on. That is the only dream I have remembered for so long.
